::: {.lead}
How does the world's coldest capital compare to sunny Florida? Explore 2023 temperature and rainfall trends between **Sarasota, FL** and **Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia**.
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon=false}
### 🌡️ At a Glance
- **Sarasota:** Consistently warm year-round with frequent tropical rainfall.
- **Ulaanbaatar:** Dramatic seasonal swings—warm summers followed by sub-zero winter extremes below -30°F.
:::

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
from datetime import datetime
from meteostat import config, hourly

config.block_large_requests = False

start = datetime(2023, 1, 1)
end = datetime(2023, 12, 31, 23, 59)

stations = {
    "Sarasota": "KSRQ0",
    "Ulaanbaatar": "44292",
}

records = []

for city, station in stations.items():
    df = hourly(station, start, end).fetch()
    if df is None or df.empty:
        continue

    df = df.reset_index().rename(columns={"time": "date"})
    df = df[["date", "temp", "prcp"]].dropna().copy()
    df["city"] = city
    df = df.rename(columns={"temp": "temp_c", "prcp": "rainfall_mm"})
    df["temp_f"] = (df["temp_c"] * 9 / 5) + 32
    records.append(df)

daily_df = pd.concat(records, ignore_index=True)
daily_df = daily_df.sort_values(["city", "date"]).reset_index(drop=True)
```

## Daily Temperature Comparison

```{python}
fig_temp = px.scatter(
    daily_df,
    x="date",
    y="temp_f",
    color="temp_f",
    symbol="city",
    opacity=0.7,
    trendline="lowess",
    color_continuous_scale=[[0, "#1e3a8a"], [0.5, "#f4d35e"], [1, "#d9480f"]],
    labels={"city": "City", "temp_f": "Temperature (°F)", "date": "Date"},
    title="Daily Temperature Across 2023"
)

fig_temp.update_layout(
    template="plotly_white",
    width=750,
    height=450,
    coloraxis_colorbar=dict(title="°F")
)
fig_temp.show()
```

Notice how Ulaanbaatar drops far below 32°F in winter and rises to warm summer highs, while Sarasota stays relatively mild all year.

## Daily Rainfall Comparison

```{python}
fig_rain = px.scatter(
    daily_df,
    x="date",
    y="rainfall_mm",
    color="city",
    opacity=0.5,
    trendline="lowess",
    category_orders={"city": ["Sarasota", "Ulaanbaatar"]},
    labels={"city": "City", "rainfall_mm": "Rainfall (mm)", "date": "Date"},
    title="Daily Rainfall Across 2023"
)

fig_rain.update_layout(
    template="plotly_white",
    width=750,
    height=450,
    colorway=["#1C6E8C", "#D96C06"]
)
fig_rain.show()
```

Watch the rainfall pattern across the year: Ulaanbaatar has a distinct summer spike, while Sarasota shows heavier tropical rainfall over multiple days throughout the year.

## Daily summary

```{python}
summary = daily_df.groupby("city").agg(
    avg_temp_f=("temp_f", "mean"),
    total_rainfall_mm=("rainfall_mm", "sum")
).round(2)
summary
```
